task.title: Recording a Video
task.shortdesc: Record your current scene to a local video file.

step.cmd: Build the scene you want to record and confirm it's selected.
Check the Audio Mixer to confirm the correct microphone and desktop audio sources are unmuted at reasonable levels.
Click Start Recording in the Controls panel.
Perform the actions you want captured.

taskbody.result: The recording is saved to the output folder configured in Settings > Output.
